name: revision-request
description: Prepare revision requests for human review in VS Code before changing source files.

interface.longDescription: Create .rr proposals from the current source, open the VS Code review preview, and check review results. Source changes stay pending until reviewed. Requires the Revision Request VS Code extension, a trusted local workspace, and Node.js 22 or newer.
defaultPrompt: Create a Revision Request proposal for these changes and open it for my review.
